title: Legal Counsel Customs and Export Controls Governance (m/f/d)
description: OPEN TO APPLICANTS IN LATAM with experience in customs and export controls and legal background. Fresenius Medical Care is the world’s leading provider of products and services for individuals with renal diseases of which around 3.9 million patients worldwide regularly undergo dialysis treatment. We care for more than 344,000 dialysis patients and provide our products in around 150 countries. With a strong focus on innovation, quality, and customer satisfaction, we have consistently achieved remarkable growth and established ourselves as a trusted brand in the dialysis market. Purpose and Scope As a Legal Counsel Customs and Export Controls Governance (m/f/d) , you will contribute to the legal backbone of Fresenius Medical Care’s global trade operations. In this role, you will provide legal guidance on customs and export control matters, support the development of compliant and cost-efficient supply chains, and help integrate trade governance into our global processes. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure adherence to international trade laws and internal policies, while driving continuous improvement and automation in trade-related legal frameworks. This is an exciting opportunity to grow within a dynamic legal environment and make a meaningful impact on global healthcare logistics. Principal Duties and Responsibilities Provide legal advice, counsel and guidance and on a range of trade governance matters such as customs and export controls, free trade agreements, special customs regimes and related risk management issues. Ensure that FME and affiliates operate globally in accordance with applicable trade governance laws and regulations, as well as applicable and relevant internal policies. Support and advise on the development and optimization of supply chains and flows of goods to achieve cost optimization in accordance with global trade laws. Support the integration and automation of trade governance processes into FME’s global operations and processes from a legal perspective. Support the development, implementation and continuous improvement of Global Standard Operating Procedures (GSOPs) for customs and export controls, providing legal guidance and review in collaboration with stakeholders. Continuous review of customs and export controls legislation and its applicability to FME business models and transactions. Legal support and guidance in customs broker engagement and performance reviews. Collaboration with stakeholders and the Customs and Export Controls Governance team for assessing training needs. Support global development and customization of trainings to FME professionals involved in trade-related activities. Support the coordination of global support for handling trade authorities’ audits, reviews and challenges. Support in the development for automation of trade-related processes and activities. Education Fully qualified lawyer, incl. above-average university degree. Experience and Required Skills 8+ years experience in customs and export controls in an international law firm and/or in-house legal department of an internationally operating and complex corporation, specializing in customs and export control matters. Preferred Master’s degree or equivalent. Experience in roll-out and implementation of customs and export control policies, processes and trainings. Ideally, experience in the healthcare sector. Technical Skills Good knowledge of global trade, including customs, and export control laws and regulations. Knowledge of relevant commercial, tax and supply chain processes. Ability to understand and apply regulatory requirements to business operations. Experience with relevant trade compliance tools or willingness to learn. Excellent written and spoken English, additional languages highly welcome. Soft Skills Innovation Mindset: embrace use of technology, automation and data analytics. Ability to work autonomously and to remotely. Ability to interpret complex customs and export control laws and regulations and apply them to real-world situations. Ability to deal with ambiguity, complexity and conflicting priorities, whilst keeping a focus on main drivers. Sound legal judgment under time pressure, balancing legal risk with business goals. Global mindset and cultural sensitivity, with the ability to work effectively across regions and time zones. Humor, highest professionalism for Fresenius Medical Care combined with self-modesty. Distinct and highly committed team-player. Team player with strong and effective communication and relationship skills. High ethical standards and professionalism. High attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy. Willingness to travel. Location Role allows for a remote hybrid working model in accordance with company policies. #J-18808-Ljbffr

description: Manager, Stadium Entertainment Department: Events & Entertainment Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time Location: Brazil Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team. The Position The Stadium Entertainment Manager will be responsible for the planning, coordination and delivery of all in‑stadium entertainment activations across all assigned venues of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. Reporting to the Head of Entertainment and supporting the Stadium Entertainment Senior Manager, this role ensures that all entertainment elements — including pre‑match programming, music, audio‑visual content, half‑time activations, and fan engagement moments — are delivered to the highest standard. The role supports and coordinates the implementation of the Stadium Entertainment operational delivery across the entire FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, in accordance with the Stadium Entertainment Concept developed by FIFA. Working closely with venue teams, technical suppliers, and the broader Entertainment department, the Stadium Entertainment Manager will act as the primary entertainment point of contact for their assigned venue(s), managing operational workflows, coordinating suppliers, and overseeing delivery timelines from a central coordination function. This role works in close collaboration with the on‑site venue entertainment teams, providing the planning structure, content, and operational direction required for seamless execution on match days. The Stadium Entertainment Manager is an office‑based coordination role suited to an experienced live events professional with strong project management skills, who can drive high‑quality entertainment delivery across multiple venues through effective planning, clear communication, and proactive stakeholder management. Key Responsibilities Stadium Entertainment Delivery Manage the day‑to‑day planning and delivery of all entertainment activations at assigned venue(s). Execute the FIFA‑approved Entertainment Concept at venue level, maintaining quality and consistency throughout the tournament. Coordinate all entertainment elements on match days, including pre‑match shows, half‑time activations, music programming and AV content. Act as the primary on‑site entertainment point of contact for venue management, technical crews, and Functional Area partners. Team Support Support the Stadium Entertainment Team by contributing to day‑to‑day coordination, operational readiness, and delivery standards across all entertainment activities. Assist with the onboarding and support of Stadium Entertainment personnel—including full‑time staff, freelancers, and event‑time workforce—helping ensure consistent standards and operational preparedness. Contribute to internal talent development through daily guidance, structured feedback, and knowledge sharing within the entertainment workstream. Support effective collaboration across creative, technical, and operational units involved in stadium entertainment delivery. Contribute to coordination between venue‑based entertainment teams to maintain consistency in delivery standards and operational execution across all stadiums. Foster strong teamwork, knowledge exchange, and operational alignment with the Ceremonies Team to ensure unified delivery across entertainment and ceremonial workstreams. Technical & Production Coordination Liaise with technical suppliers including AV, LED, sound, and lighting providers to ensure correct installation and operation of all entertainment infrastructure. Support pre‑event technical surveys, production walkthroughs, and infrastructure assessments at assigned venues. Coordinate rehearsals and technical run‑throughs, ensuring all entertainment elements are tested and validated before match day. Manage show rundowns, cue sheets, and entertainment schedules for each match at assigned venue(s). Venue Readiness & Execution Support the preparation of Site Operational Plans (SOPs), stadium production schedules, and PMC rundowns for Stadium Entertainment. Assist in preproduction processes, including coordinating technical surveys, gathering stadium LED screen specs, AV infrastructure reviews, and supplier installation planning. Contribute to readiness activities and provide on‑site support during live operations to ensure delivery standards are met. Support problem solving during matchday entertainment, escalating issues to the Senior Manager as needed. Coordinate rehearsal planning, scheduling, documentation, and stakeholder communication in alignment with Senior Manager guidance. Support the validation of entertainment elements during pre‑event testing and rehearsal phases. Assist with venue‑level pre‑production tasks, including gathering technical information, supporting infrastructure assessments, and coordinating installation planning. Content Production & Management Coordinate the receipt, testing, and deployment of all entertainment content at venue level, including music, video, graphics, and scripts. Ensure that all content is approved, correctly formatted, and delivered on time in line with operational deadlines. Maintain accurate records of content usage and ensure IP/copyright compliance at venue level. Planning Scheduling & Documentation Prepare match‑day reports, schedules, show notes and post‑event summaries for the Stadium Entertainment Senior Manager. Maintain up‑to‑date operational documentation including rundowns, contact lists, and venue entertainment plans. Participate in regular team meetings, briefings, and review sessions. Flag operational risks and elevate issues to the Stadium Entertainment Senior Manager in a timely manner. Supplier & Budget Management Support procurement processes as directed by the Stadium Entertainment Senior Manager, including supplier briefing and evaluation. Manage day‑to‑day relationships with entertainment suppliers and contractors at assigned venue(s). Assist with budget management tasks, including forecasting inputs, cost‑tracking, variation documentation, and invoice processing, ensuring accuracy and timely follow‑up. Help monitor contractual deliverables and timelines, ensuring they remain aligned with pre‑production schedules and operational readiness requirements, and escalating risks to the Senior Manager as needed. Stakeholder & Functional Area Liaison Coordinate with Venue Operations, Broadcast, Protocol, Safety, and other Functional Areas and stakeholders to integrate entertainment seamlessly into match‑day operations. Support early‑phase cross‑functional integration to support seamless operational delivery. Other Duties Perform additional responsibilities as required by line management aligned with project delivery. Support the Head of Entertainment and Senior Stadium Entertainment Manager in planning, operational readiness, and tournament‑wide entertainment integration. Support cross‑venue entertainment activities and cover other venues as required during the tournament. Your Profile Education Bachelor's degree or similar level of higher education or equivalent in industry experience. Experience 5+ years' experience in live event production and ceremonies management, ideally within major international sporting events or large‑scale public events. Demonstrated experience delivering in‑venue or stadium entertainment programmes, including AV, music and audience engagement activations. Experience working within large‑scale multi‑venue events or major international sporting events is highly desirable. Track record of coordinating multiple suppliers and technical teams in high‑pressure, time‑critical environments. Experience working with broadcast operations and an understanding of live TV production constraints is an advantage. Skills & Competencies Administrative skills: Ability to manage office and production documentation including RFPs, presentations, show rundowns, rehearsal schedules, scripts, and permits accurately. Adaptability: Ability to adapt to evolving creative direction and operational challenges in high‑pressure environments. Flexibility: Willingness to work irregular hours, including evenings and weekends, across the full tournament period. Communication skills: Outstanding written and verbal communication skills; able to manage complex stakeholder relationships at a senior level. Organizational skills: Exceptional project management skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent ceremony workstreams to tight deadlines. Problem‑solving skills: Strategic and creative approach to problem‑solving; ability to make clear decisions under pressure. Cross‑functional collaboration: Proven ability to work collaboratively across internal teams and diverse functional areas, ensuring alignment and contributing to the successful achievement of delivery goals. Interpersonal skills: Builds effective working relationships across internal and cross‑functional teams, applying strong interpersonal skills to support smooth coordination and operational alignment. Cultural sensitivity: Deep awareness and respect for diverse cultures; committed to ensuring ceremonies are inclusive, authentic, and globally resonant. Passion for entertainment: Genuine passion for live performance, ceremony production, and the power of sport to inspire. Certifications & Requirements Fluent in English and Brazilian Portuguese. Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning/collaboration tools. Experience with Monday.com an advantage. description: Descrição da vaga A Supergasbras é uma empresa do grupo holandês SHV Energy, líder mundial na distribuição de Gás liquefeito de Petróleo (GLP), com mais de 100 anos de experiência. Nosso negócio é levar energia limpa e eficiente para milhões de brasileiros, seja nas suas casas, comércios, indústrias ou agronegócio. Os mais de 76 anos de atuação no Brasil nos posiciona como uma das principais distribuidoras nacionais de GLP - comercializamos cerca de 1,5 milhão de toneladas do produto por ano com aproximadamente 20% de participação de mercado. Nossa estratégia é conseguir através da confiança e integridade, ser a melhor empresa de Energia do Brasil para nossos clientes, parceiros, colaboradores e acionistas, com responsabilidade socioambiental. Diversidade e inclusão é uma prioridade de negócios para a Supergasbras. Valorizamos e acreditamos no desenvolvimento de pessoas, tanto no contexto profissional como pessoal, tendo como estratégia a equidade de gênero, inclusão de pessoas com deficiência, respeito a todas as orientações sexuais e luta contra a discriminação racial nas diferentes camadas da sociedade. Esta oportunidade também está publicada no portal global de vagas da SHV Energy e faz parte do nosso compromisso de atrair talentos que compartilham dos nossos valores, independente da localização. Responsabilidades e atribuições Objetivo do Cargo: O(a) Analista Tributário Sênior é responsável por definições em projetos da empresa, suportando diversas áreas com informações embasadas na legislação, apoia na implementação da estratégia tática de implementação de cada alteração legal que impacte em sistemas e operações afastando o risco fiscal e atuando com bastante autonomia, mas dando visibilidade a ampla a equipe. E para isso será requerido profundo domínio da legislação tributária e sólida interlocução com órgãos fiscais em âmbito nacional. Espera-se que o profissional conduza suas atividades de forma independente, necessitando de suporte apenas para questões administrativas e procedimentos internos da companhia. Além da excelência técnica, o cargo requer postura profissional íntegra, elevado senso de responsabilidade, respeito nas relações interpessoais e aderência aos valores éticos e comportamentais da organização. O profissional será peça-chave para viabilizar a implementação da Reforma Tributária do Consumo, contribuindo ativamente para a conformidade e eficiência dos processos fiscais atuais e novos. Responsabilidades: Apuração dos tributos indiretos (ISS, ICMS, IPI) conforme legislação aplicável e atualizada. Elaborar e transmitir obrigações acessórias (SCANC, SPED Fiscal, GIA, entre outras). Acompanhar todas as mudanças relativas a RTC no que tange a IBS, CBS e IS, bem como as normas relativas a DF-es e Obrigações acessórias. Analisar e validar informações fiscais provenientes das Notas Fiscais Eletrônicas (NF-e), incluindo contingências. Monitorar continuamente a legislação e interpretar e trazer para discussão em grupo as alterações na legislação tributária e avaliar impactos nos processos internos. Prestar atendimento a fiscalizações e auditorias. Acompanhar e compreender os impactos da Reforma Tributária nos processos e obrigações fiscais em geral. Experiência: Experiência mínima de 5 anos na Área Tributária, com foco em tributos indiretos (ICMS, ISS, IPI, PIS e COFINS) e conhecimento em NFe (xml e regras de validação). description: About Us Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 122 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we're building. Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human. Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. About Nubank’s Mobile Platform and App Core The Mobile Platform’s mission aligns with Nubank’s commitment to delivering the best experience for our customers by ensuring a high-performing, stable, and seamless app. Within Mobile Platform, App Core focuses on providing user-friendly, scalable, high-performing, and cost-efficient app infrastructure components and mobile tools that enable Nubank engineers to quickly and safely test, deploy, monitor, analyze, and improve app flows and features. App Core is at the heart of the Nubank app’s foundation, powering app performance, infrastructure scalability, and the removal of legacy dependencies to allow our application to grow from millions to potentially billions of fanatic customers. The Opportunity This role will involve working across a variety of technologies, including Native , Flutter , and related frameworks . We are looking for a Lead Mobile Engineer with solid experience to join the App Core team — a cross-impact engineering team responsible for building and maintaining the core infrastructure of the mobile application, optimizing our performance, and enabling product teams to deliver high-quality mobile experiences. What We’re Looking For Must Have: Strong technical background with Flutter and/or native mobile development (Android/iOS). Solid understanding of mobile software engineering principles, architectural patterns, and modularization strategies. Experience with performance optimization, dependency injection, and migration of core systems. Knowledge of mobile observability, monitoring, and debugging tools. Strong communication skills in English, with the ability to explain complex concepts to diverse audiences. Track record of delivering results in ambiguous, fast-paced environments. Nice to Have: Experience with backend technologies, especially those integrated with mobile applications. Familiarity with distributed systems and large-scale app architecture. Contributions to internal SDKs, libraries, or mobile design systems. Understanding of user authentication, session management, and app state handling. Why Join Us Impact at Scale: Help shape the mobile experience for millions of customers across multiple countries, with the goal of reaching billions. Technical Leadership: Influence the architecture and foundational technologies that all Nubank engineers rely on. Innovation-Driven Culture: Work in a dynamic, collaborative environment that values experimentation, continuous improvement, and engineering excellence. title: Senior Manager, Ceremonies
description: Senior Manager, Ceremonies Department: Events & Entertainment Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time Location: Brazil Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC27”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. THE POSITION The Ceremonies Senior Manager leads the end‑to‑end planning, creative development, and operational delivery of all official ceremonies for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, including the Opening and Closing Ceremonies, Medal and Trophy Ceremonies, Pre‑Match Ceremonies (PMC), the Final Match Half‑Time Show (if applicable), and all additional ceremonial moments. Reporting to the Head of Entertainment, this role is responsible for overseeing the full lifecycle of each ceremony—from planning and preparation through to live execution—ensuring full alignment with FIFA’s vision and brand standards. The role also manages the implementation of the operational delivery across the entire FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, in accordance with the Ceremonies Concept developed by FIFA. Working closely with the Entertainment team and key Functional Areas, the Ceremonies Senior Manager acts as the senior operational lead for all ceremony delivery, ensuring creative and operational approvals are met and delivering iconic, culturally resonant moments that celebrate women’s football on its biggest global stage. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Ceremonies Project Leadership Lead the operational delivery and implementation of the Ceremonies Concept provided by FIFA. Manage the end-to-end planning and delivery of all official ceremonies across the FWWC27 tournament. Oversee ceremonies planning and delivery from concept development through preproduction, execution, dissolution, and legacy handover. Ensure full alignment with the Entertainment team in Zurich across all ceremonial workstreams. Manage the approval process for all ceremony related creative and operational deliverables. Provide senior decision-making support on creative direction, technical feasibility, and operational prioritisation. Lead the development of ceremony operational plans, production schedules, rundowns, and show formats for all ceremonies, including PMC. Coordinate with Venue Management, Broadcast, Safety & Security, and other Functional Areas to integrate ceremonies seamlessly into matchday and event day operations. Act as the senior escalation authority for all ceremony related operational matters. Ensure all ceremonies reflect the approved creative vision, brand standards, cultural sensitivities, and tournament wide entertainment strategy. Team Leadership Manage and mentor the Ceremonies Team, providing clear direction, performance oversight, and accountability structures. Mentor and support all Ceremonies personnel, including fulltime staff, freelancers, and event time workforce, ensuring consistent standards, development pathways, and operational readiness. Support internal talent development through coaching, guidance, and structured feedback. Build team structures and optimize collaboration across creative, technical, and operational units. Foster strong coordination between venue based ceremonies teams to maintain consistency in delivery standards and operational execution. Foster strong teamwork, knowledge exchange, and operational alignment with the Stadium Entertainment Team to ensure unified delivery across all entertainment and ceremonial workstreams. Major Ceremonies Oversight Manage planning and delivery management for all major ceremonial events, including: Opening Ceremony, Closing Ceremony, Medal and Trophy Ceremonies, Final Match Half-Time Show (if applicable), Pre-Match Ceremonies throughout the tournament Ensure that each major ceremony reflects the ambition, brand standards, and cultural significance of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. Creative & Concept Development / Creative Concept, Content Production & Management Collaborate with the Entertainment team to develop and refine the ceremonial concept and creative direction for each ceremony. Integrate host country cultural elements into ceremonial programming in a meaningful, authentic, and respectful way. Oversee creative brief development, content commissioning, and pre-production workflows with internal teams and external agencies. Ensure all creative content — including music, graphics, videos, scripts, translations, choreography and performances — is approved and locked in line with operational timelines. Manage stakeholder approval pathways to ensure content is delivered and archived in accordance with operational requirements. Manage IP and copyright compliance for all ceremony content. Planning Scheduling & Documentation Develop and maintain detailed project plans, WIP reports, and milestone trackers for all ceremony workstreams. Ensure all operational and creative decisions are fully documented and version controlled. Manage multiple suppliers, conduct regular update meetings, coordinate implementation processes, and supervise payments and reporting. Prepare written and oral presentations, high-level briefings, and reports for senior leadership and FIFA counterparts. Organize and participate in Review, Project Team, and Status Update meetings. Lead the creation, management, and archiving of project plans, workflows, venue documentation, and readiness tools across all ceremony workstreams. Manage the development of operational plans, production schedules, rundowns, and rehearsal programmes for all ceremonies. Ensure readiness standards are met at all ceremony venues and oversee execution on the day of each event. Act as the key operational decision-maker to maintain seamless delivery during live ceremonies. Oversee rehearsal planning, scheduling, approvals and stakeholder coordination for all ceremonies. Direct venue-level pre-production processes including technical surveys, staging assessments, and infrastructure planning. Supplier & Budget Management Lead early stage budget modelling, scenario planning, and resourcing strategies to support creative and operational planning. Develop and manage Scopes of Work, Procurement activities, supplier evaluations, contract negotiations, in line with FWWC27 management and procurement policies. Manage procurement activities for stadium entertainment suppliers, including RFP development, evaluation, and contract negotiation. Maintain full budget oversight including forecasting, cost control, variations, and invoicing. Manage budget oversight for the stadium entertainment workstream, including forecasting, cost control and invoicing. Ensure contractual deliverables and timelines are aligned with preproduction schedules and operational readiness requirements. Conduct regular supplier update meetings and coordinate implementation processes. Supervise payments, deliverables and performance reports from entertainment suppliers. Stakeholder & Functional Area Liaison Act as the senior liaison between the Ceremonies Team and all relevant Functional Areas, including Venue Operations, Broadcast, Safety & Security, Marketing, and FIFA SPE. Deliver concise briefings, alignment updates, and escalation management across all internal and external stakeholders. Build and maintain relationships with Host Country national bodies, cultural organizations, and local partners contributing to ceremonies. Ensure early phase cross functional integration to support seamless operational delivery. Venue Readiness & Execution Lead preparation of Site Operational Plans (SOPs), ceremony production schedules, and PMC rundowns. Direct venue level preproduction processes including technical surveys, staging assessments, performer logistics, and infrastructure planning. Ensure readiness standards are met at all ceremony venues and oversee execution on the day of each event. Act as the key operational decision maker to maintain seamless delivery during live ceremonies. Oversee rehearsal planning, scheduling, approvals and stakeholder coordination. Ensure all creative and technical elements are validated during pre event testing and rehearsal phases. Other Duties Perform additional responsibilities as required by senior managership aligned with project delivery. Represent the Ceremonies function in cross-functional planning forums and senior managership briefings. Support the Head of Entertainment in strategic planning, operational readiness, and tournament wide entertainment integration. YOUR PROFILE Education Bachelor's degree or similar level of higher education or equivalent in industry experience. Experience 7+ years' experience in live event production and ceremonies management, ideally within major international sporting events or large-scale public events. Prior experience in a FIFA tournament or comparable major international sports event is highly desirable. Demonstrated experience managing complex, large-scale ceremonies including opening/closing ceremonies and awards presentations. Proven track record in team managership, creative development, supplier management, and cross-functional coordination. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável. Translate complex financial and operational data into clear, actionable insights for non‑finance stakeholders. Act as a trusted finance partner to Clinical Solutions department heads, supporting planning, performance reviews, and strategic initiatives. Prepare and deliver high‑quality presentations and executive‑ready materials summarizing portfolio performance, risks, and recommendations. Approximately 5-8 years of relevant experience in project finance, FP&A, or operational finance, with a strong preference for CRO or clinical research industry experience. Demonstrated experience managing or analysing clinical trial portfolios and complex project financials. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (financial modelling, scenario analysis, large data sets). Working knowledge of Power BI or similar BI/visualization tools. Strong presentation and communication skills, with experience presenting to senior leaders and department heads. Solid understanding of clinical trial financial drivers, project lifecycles, and contract/budget mechanics. Knowledge, Skills & Competencies Strong financial and analytical acumen with the ability to connect operational activity to financial outcomes. Executive presence and confidence interacting with senior operational leaders. Ability to synthesize complex data into clear narratives and recommendations. High attention to detail balanced with a portfolio‑level, strategic mindset. Self‑motivated, adaptable, and comfortable operating in a fast‑paced, matrixed environment. Garantir robustez e clareza nas recomendações de engenharia de reservatórios, incluindo comunicação transparente de incertezas, premissas e sensibilidades. Contribuir para a tomada de decisão dos ativos dentro do framework de governança e validação da afiliada. Profil du candidat – Experiência Mais de 8 anos de experiência profissional em engenharia de reservatórios. Forte cultura de subsolo, com conhecimento operacional (preparação de poços, perfuração/completação e monitoramento), prática avançada de modelagem geológica e de reservatórios, gestão de incertezas, desenvolvimento de reservatórios, previsão de produção, avaliação de reservas e colaboração interdisciplinar. description: Software Engineer, Brazil - X Delivery – BCG X Software Engineer, Brazil - X Delivery – BCG X Locations: São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro Who We Are Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation‑inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom‑line impact. To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading‑edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive. Working across industries and disciplines, we combine our experience and expertise to tackle the biggest challenges faced by society today. We go beyond what was once thought possible, creating new and innovative solutions to the world’s most complex problems. Leveraging BCG’s global network and partnerships with leading organizations, BCG X provides a stable ecosystem for talent to build game‑changing businesses, products, and services from the ground up, all while growing their career. Together, we strive to create solutions that will positively impact the lives of millions. You will collaborate with premier consulting teams around the world, applying your software development expertise across a variety of ambitious and ground‑breaking international projects. You will be instrumental in advancing BCG’s Consulting and BCG X teams by providing critical software development insights and speeding up project execution. As a Software Engineer, your role involves close collaboration with consulting teams to address complex and diverse technological challenges. You will apply your expertise in software development methodologies to add value to BCG’s Consulting & BCG X teams and Practice Areas. Each project offers a unique opportunity to showcase your skills and make a significant impact within BCG and our esteemed clientele. What You’ll Bring We are seeking technologically adept engineers who bring strong experience and diverse skills to our dynamic team. This role is an outstanding opportunity for someone who is passionate about software development and embraces opportunities to learn and make an impact in a fast‑paced, innovative environment. If you’re driven by technology and ready for impactful challenges, our BCG X Delivery team could be a great match! Technical Skills – Knowledge and Experience With Coding Skills: Strong coding skills and proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Java, Kotlin, Node.js, Go, Ruby, Rust, C#, etc. Experience with multiple languages preferred. Familiarity with CI/CD tools like CircleCI, Jenkins, etc. Tech curiosity with interest and exposure to technologies like AR/VR, IoT, AI, Blockchain. Knowledge of infrastructure as code practices using Terraform, Chef, Puppet, or Ansible. Job Requirements Bachelor’s / Master’s in Computer Science or a related field Fluency in Portuguese and English Proven background in end‑to‑end application development, preferably in a commercial or consulting environment. Active contributions to open‑source projects or technical communities are highly valued. Core Attributes Software Development: Demonstrated experience in developing, testing, and deploying robust software. Examples of past projects or contributions are advantageous. Full Lifecycle Experience: Active involvement in the complete software development lifecycle, showcasing skills from idea generation to deployment. Efficiency Optimization: Experience in optimizing software for performance and efficiency. Dynamic Adaptability: Ability to thrive in a fast‑paced, client‑facing environment. Experience in client interactions for product development is a plus. Collaborative Skills: A track record of working effectively in team settings, sharing ideas, and co‑developing solutions. Additional Information Please apply for the positions equivalent to your previous work experiences. The seniority will be evaluated according to your experience and career structure at BCG X during the process. Investimos fortemente nas nossas equipes e assim cada um consegue aproveitar desenvolvimento profissional, oportunidades de carreira excepcionais e mobilidade em todo o nosso grupo. SOBRE A VAGA A Escola Eleva é uma das escolas Inspired no Brasil. Aqui nós temos vocação para ensinar e paixão por aprender. Nosso time é movido por excelência, entusiasmo, respeito e responsabilidade. Somos adeptos da mentalidade de crescimento e estamos constantemente motivados a buscar o que há de melhor em educação, no Brasil e no mundo e em pensar as melhores maneiras de aplicar isso em nossas escolas e inspirar nossos alunos. Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de líderes capazes de fazer a diferença em suas vidas e contribuir para um mundo melhor. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos e movidos por entusiasmo. Dessa forma, a lista acima não é restritiva e pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se aplicam ao cargo. REQUISITOS O que você precisa ter: Diploma de Licenciatura em História; Experiência com Fundamental 2; Inglês fluente para ministrar aulas nesse idioma. title: Principal Product Manager, HTS API Marketplace
description: About the Role We are seeking an exceptional Principal Product Manager to build the HTS API Marketplace — the commercial and developer-facing layer through which enterprise partners access Hopper's lodging and cars capabilities. This is a true 0-to-1 role. You will be the person who defines what it is: how capabilities are packaged and priced, how partners discover and integrate them, and how the marketplace evolves as a platform business. The underlying technical capabilities — connectivity orchestration, pricing and sort, content mapping, the extranet — are owned by dedicated capability teams. Your job is to work closely with those PMs to understand, package, and commercially expose those capabilities as coherent, enterprise-grade API products. We expect this PM to move fast and build scrappily. You should be comfortable using AI tools and vibe coding to prototype workflows, mock APIs, and test partner experiences before handing off to engineering. The best candidate will reach for a prototype before a PRD. You will partner with Engineering, Data Science, Commercial, Finance, and Supply — and coordinate tightly with other PMs across the organization — to bring the marketplace from concept to a revenue-generating platform. This is a fully remote role. What Would Your Day-to-day Look Like Define what the HTS API Marketplace is: how capabilities are structured, packaged, and priced across a portfolio spanning HTS Connect, Search Polygons, Autocomplete, Ranking, Content & Property Mapping, Room Mapping, Deduplication/Auction, Pricing, Extranet, Taxes, and Custom Deals Engine. Coordinate with capability PMs — who own the underlying technical systems — to understand each capability's roadmap, constraints, and customization surface, and translate that into externally-consumable API products. Own the commercial model for the marketplace: platform vs. variable fee decisions, take rate structure per capability, enterprise packaging, and the custom deals framework for large partners with differentiated customer segments. Build the developer and partner experience from scratch: API specifications, partner onboarding flows, documentation standards, sandbox environments, and integration tooling that minimizes time-to-first-value. Use AI tools and rapid prototyping to test ideas quickly — mock API responses, prototype partner portals, simulate pricing and ranking configurations — before committing engineering resources. Establish the go-to-market motion for the marketplace: work with Commercial to identify the right partners for each capability, sequence launches, and define what a successful commercial rollout looks like. Own the marketplace revenue P&L: model and track GBV, take rate, and per-capability unit economics in partnership with Finance. Set the sequencing and prioritization across all capabilities — from in-progress work (HTS Connect, Taxes) through scoping-stage products (Content & Property Mapping, Room Mapping, Deduplication/Auction, Pricing) to capabilities not yet started (Search Polygons, Autocomplete, Ranking, Extranet, Custom Deals Engine). Qualifications 7+ years of Product Management experience, with at least one 0-to-1 product you built from concept to commercial launch. Demonstrated experience building developer-facing or B2B marketplace products, including ownership of API product design, developer experience, and commercial packaging for enterprise customers. AI-native working style: you use LLMs and vibe coding as first-line tools for prototyping, not as novelties. You have built working demos, mockups, or proof-of-concepts using AI before handing work to engineering. Strong understanding of marketplace economics: take rates, supply-side incentives, demand-side optimization, and the design of platform vs. variable commercial models. Ability to coordinate effectively across multiple product teams — you can synthesize roadmaps, surface dependencies, and drive cross-team alignment without owning the underlying engineering. Experience working with external enterprise partners: translating commercial needs into product requirements and managing partner expectations through multi-phase rollouts. Strong fluency with SQL and large-scale transactional or operational datasets. Exceptional written and verbal communication, including the ability to write crisp API and product documentation. Bonus Experience in travel commerce (lodging, cars, flights) or adjacent industries such as fintech, ads, or marketplace infrastructure. Background in connectivity, distribution, or supplier technology (GDS, channel managers, OTA APIs). Prior experience in Engineering, Data Science, or a technical role. Familiarity with auction or deduplication mechanics, dynamic pricing systems, or recommendation and ranking models. Perks & Benefits Of Working With Us Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and upsides of pre-IPO equity packages. Hopper will offer and cover 100% of employee premiums for private Major & Minor Medical insurances. Hopper supplements Social Security coverage for liability benefits with Private insurance to cover you and your loved ones from Day 1. Hopper provides employees with a tax-advantageous and secured savings vehicle and matches up to a percentage of employee contributions. Please ask us about our very generous parental leave, much above industry standards!. Unlimited PTO. Flexdesk coworking All Access Pass AND Work-from-home stipend. Carrot Cash travel stipend. Hopper offers a monthly subsidy to pay for teleworking utilities. An entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business. Open communication with management and company leadership. Small, dynamic teams = massive impact. More About Hopper At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally – powering Hopper’s mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world-class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions – helping people travel better and save more on their trips. The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers – with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials. While everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands. Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners’ direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end-to-end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more. Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company’s recent growth: Billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS’ channels every year. Our fintech products – including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance – have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no-questions-asked resolutions. Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking; and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking vs if they booked just travel. Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business. Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies, etc.) can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper’s fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co-develop Capital One Travel, a new travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines and many more. Hopper has been named the #1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company. Hopper has been downloaded over 120 million times and continues to have millions of new installs each month. Hopper is now the #3 largest online travel agencies in North America and 70% of our app customers are Gen-Z and millennials travelers. Hopper has raised over $750 million USD of private capital and is backed by some of the largest institutional investors and banks in the world. HTS is primed to continue its growth as the leading travel ecommerce provider in a $1 trillion online shopping category. The Hopper app and website will also continue to be the preferred travel provider for Gen Z and Millennials. Come take off with us! Compensation Range: $150K - $450K #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Pricing & Payments Manager, Partner Strategy & Experience
description: Pricing & Payments Manager, Partner Strategy & Experience Amazon is the most customer-centric company on Earth. We need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people who are passionate about doing the right thing. We are looking for a Pricing & Payments Manager to lead the Pricing, Incentives, Payments & Disputes function within Amazon's Last Mile Brazil organization. This role owns the end-to-end strategy and execution of partner pricing models, incentive programs, payment accuracy, and dispute resolution across our Amazon Partner Logistics programs — EDSP (External Delivery Service Provider), AMPL (Amazon Partner Logistics), and AMXL (Amazon Extra Large). As a People Manager, you will lead and develop a team of specialists, set the strategic direction for pricing and payment mechanisms, build scalable processes, and drive cross‑functional alignment with Finance, Operations, and Procurement to ensure partner economics are competitive, accurate, and sustainable. This position is based out of an Amazon corporate office and may require periodic travel. If you are passionate about partner economics, operational excellence, and building high‑performing teams, you should join our team. Key job responsibilities Lead, coach, and develop a team of Pricing, Incentives, Payments & Disputes specialists, fostering a culture of ownership, analytical rigor, and continuous improvement Own the end‑to‑end pricing strategy for logistics partners across EDSP, AMPL, and AMXL programs, ensuring competitive and sustainable rate structures Design, implement, and optimize incentive programs that drive partner performance, network efficiency, and cost effectiveness Oversee the payment lifecycle — from invoice validation and payment accuracy to dispute identification, root‑cause analysis, and resolution Build and maintain scalable mechanisms for pricing governance, incentive tracking, payment reconciliation, and dispute management Develop structured reporting and dashboards to monitor pricing competitiveness, incentive ROI, payment accuracy, and dispute aging/resolution rates Partner cross‑functionally with Finance, Operations, Procurement, and Legal to align pricing models with business objectives and contractual frameworks Identify and drive automation opportunities to reduce manual intervention in payment and dispute processes Conduct periodic pricing benchmarking and market analysis to ensure Amazon's partner economics remain competitive Manage escalations related to partner payments and disputes, ensuring timely resolution and stakeholder alignment Define and track KPIs for the team, establishing clear goals, performance standards, and development plans for direct reports A day in the life Your day starts with metrics review and the team's priorities. Your focus centers on strategic decisions that shape partner economics across EDSP, AMPL, and AMXL. You lead cross‑functional negotiations with Finance, Operations, and Procurement to align pricing models with business objectives. You assess incentive program ROI, recommending adjustments to optimize cost efficiency and partner performance. You review payment accuracy dashboards, identifying systemic gaps and designing scalable mechanisms to address them. Between meetings, you coach your team on stakeholder influence and data‑driven storytelling. Every day balances strategic thinking, cross‑functional alignment, and talent development to drive sustainable partner economics at scale. About the team The Pricing & Payments team is part of Amazon Logistics' Partner Strategy & Experience organization, supporting the EDSP, AMXL, and AMPL programs across Brazil — a network of +30 logistics partners and +300 operational nodes. Our mission is to ensure Amazon's logistics partners operate under competitive, transparent, and accurate pricing and payment frameworks, while driving performance through well‑designed incentive programs and efficient dispute resolution. We build scalable pricing models, payment governance mechanisms, and incentive strategies that balance cost efficiency with partner sustainability. The team sits within a broader strategic structure that also covers Compliance & Communications, Network Health & Performance, and VAS & DA Experience — working cross‑functionally to support Amazon's Last Mile growth in Brazil. Basic Qualifications Bachelor's degree or equivalent in business, operations, logistics, supply chain or engineering Speak, write, and read fluent in English Experience managing and developing high‑performance teams Experience conducting sophisticated and creative analysis of complex data and translating results into actionable deliverables, messages, and presentations Experience working with cross‑functional teams across business development, marketing, operations, product development, legal, etc. Experience implementing scalable compliance solutions (technology, procedures, processes, etc.) in a regulated environment Experience in communication and presentation skills, both written and verbal in Portuguese & English Experience in deal management and pricing strategy, or financial consulting Preferred Qualifications MBA, or Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting or related field Experience using SQL or other analytical tools for conducting data analysis Experience with Lean or Six Sigma analytical techniques Experience in logistics Knowledge of Six Sigma, Lean manufacturing efforts, transportation and logistics, or fulfillment and distribution centers Experience in financial modeling, P&L management or analysis, or experience in tax, finance or a related analytical field Experience designing incentive programs or performance‑based compensation structures Experience building payment reconciliation or dispute management mechanisms at scale Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner. Noções de atendimento humanizado ao cliente em ambiente de saúde. Capacidade de registro correto de informações em sistemas. Capacidade de se expressar corretamente verbal e na escrita. Competências comportamentais: Comunicação e capacidade para lidar com conflitos: Habilidade de construir e manter relacionamentos dentro e fora do setor Operacional. Clareza oral e escrita, capacidade de expressar suas ideias. Capacidade para ouvir e entender a necessidade dos clientes externos e internos das demais áreas do negócio. Iniciativa: proatividade para identificar riscos e propor melhorias nos processos. Trabalho em equipe: trabalha cooperativamente, integrando pessoas e gerando uma ambiência de trabalho produtivo e colaborativo. Adaptação à mudança: entendimento e capacidade de ajustar às prioridades, direcionamentos e conjuntura. Flexibilidade para mudança de acordo com o ambiente. Habilidade para reconhecer problemas e propor soluções. Requisitos: Desejável graduação em Biomedicina. Curso Técnico em Análises Clínicas. Conhecimento em informática básica. #J-18808-Ljbffr

You will work on initiatives to enhance our brand visibility and create compelling narratives for our B2B partners and prospective partners. Data-Driven Approach: strong analytical skills; ability to translate data into actionable insights (SQL knowledge is a plus). Innovative Problem-Solving Skills: ability to tackle complex challenges and adapt to evolving scenarios. Strong Communication Skills: excellent writing and verbal communication; ability to create impactful presentations. Strategic Mindset: experience in developing content that aligns with business objectives and enhances brand narrative. Industry and Product Knowledge: familiarity with tech and travel industries; online travel agency experience is a plus. Technical Proficiency: knowledge of marketing automation tools, CRM systems, and analytics software is advantageous. Why Join Us? At Agoda, you will play a pivotal role in shaping our communication strategies and driving growth within the B2B marketing division. If you are an innovative thinker passionate about travel technology and have the skills to elevate our brand narrative, we invite you to apply and be part of our dynamic team. Há 4 dias Resumo Esta é uma oportunidade única para ingressar em um dos motores comerciais mais dinâmicos do setor de travel tech na América Latina. Como Executivo de Contas Farmer Sênior , você terá ownership real sobre uma carteira de hotéis e receptivos na região do Rio de Janeiro e Costa Verde (Paraty, Angra dos Reis, Trindade), atuando em uma das verticais de maior crescimento na Decolar. O papel exige um perfil consultivo e estratégico, com foco em rentabilização e gestão de carteira. Você será o trusted advisor dos hotéis sob sua responsabilidade, construindo relações de confiança e posicionando a Decolar como parte essencial da estratégia de crescimento dos parceiros. Para se candidatar, é essencial demonstrar experiência relevante em travel ou em vendas/account management B2B consultivo, bem como formação adequada e habilidades de análise de dados e relacionamento com parceiros. Quais serão as suas responsabilidades? Construção de Relacionamento: Desenvolver relações de confiança com os hotéis e receptivos da sua carteira, entendendo profundamente seus negócios, desafios e objetivos. Gestão Estratégica da Carteira: Monitorar e otimizar disponibilidade, competitividade tarifária, conversão e saúde do relacionamento com os parceiros, independentemente do porte do hotel. Negociação Comercial: Conduzir negociações contínuas de tarifas, inventário, promoções e mídia paga nas marcas Decolar, HotelDo, entre outras. Análise de Dados e Diagnóstico: Utilizar ferramentas como Metabase, Power BI e Excel para identificar padrões, priorizar oportunidades e criar planos de ação baseados em dados. Revisões de Performance: Realizar business reviews e visitas presenciais regulares com os parceiros, aterrissando em planos de ação concretos e prazos claros. Recomendações Consultivas: Traduzir dados e insights de mercado em recomendações acionáveis para os hotéis, garantindo que os parceiros saibam o que fazer, quando e por quê. Gestão de Pipeline: Trabalhar a carteira com disciplina de CRM (Hubspot), mantendo oportunidades mapeadas, status atualizado e follow-ups no prazo. Representação no Trade Local: Participar de visitas, feiras regionais e eventos do setor, representando a Decolar e identificando novas oportunidades de negócio. Interface com Parceiros: Traduzir atualizações de produto, pricing e distribuição em ganhos concretos para os hotéis. Para se candidatar, você precisa ter: Experiência: 3 a 5 anos em travel (hotelaria, operadoras, receptivos, OTAs) ou em vendas/account management B2B consultivo em ambientes dinâmicos. Formação: Superior completo em Administração, Turismo, Economia, Marketing ou áreas correlatas. Perfil Consultivo: Escuta ativa, postura estratégica e capacidade de ganhar confiança pela substância das recomendações. Habilidade com Dados: Excel avançado, leitura fluente de dashboards (Metabase, Power BI) e curiosidade para entender os números em profundidade. Comunicação: Clareza na comunicação, escuta ativa e habilidade para conduzir conversas comerciais do zero. Perfil de Owner: Proatividade, iniciativa e capacidade de fechar ciclos de trabalho sem necessidade de instruções constantes. Ferramentas: Experiência com CRM (Hubspot), Google Workspace e ferramentas de análise de dados. Mobilidade: Disponibilidade para viagens frequentes na região do RJ e Costa Verde. É importante que tenha CNH ativa Idiomas: Português nativo; inglês intermediário; espanhol é um diferencial. Paixão por Travel: Interesse genuíno pelo setor de hospitalidade online e turismo. Diferenciais Conhecimento da dinâmica do mercado local (RJ e Costa Verde). Local de Trabalho Base no Rio de Janeiro, com visitas frequentes aos parceiros na região. Se você é apaixonado por travel tech, tem perfil consultivo e busca um desafio estratégico em um ambiente dinâmico, essa é a sua oportunidade! #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Manager, Ceremonies
description: Department: Events & Entertainment Location: Brazil Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. THE POSITION The Ceremonies Manager supports the end to end planning, creative development, and operational delivery of all official ceremonies for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, including the Opening and Closing Ceremonies, Medal and Trophy Ceremonies, Pre Match Ceremonies (PMC), the Final Match Half Time Show (if applicable), and all additional ceremonial moments. Reporting to the Head of Entertainment, the Ceremonies Manager supports the planning and operational delivery of all official ceremonies, working closely with the Senior Manager and wider Entertainment team to ensure alignment with FIFA’s vision, brand standards. The role supports and coordinates the implementation of the operational delivery across the entire FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, ensuring that all ceremonies are executed in accordance with the Ceremonies Concept developed by FIFA. Working closely with the Entertainment Team and key Functional Areas, the Ceremonies Manager supports the Senior Manager in coordinating the operational delivery of ceremonies, contributing to creative and operational review processes and helping ensure the execution of iconic, culturally resonant moments that celebrate women’s football on its biggest global stage. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Ceremonies Project Leadership Support the operational delivery and implementation of the Ceremonies Concept provided by FIFA. Support the end-to-end planning and delivery of all official ceremonies across the FWWC27 tournament. Oversee ceremonies planning and delivery from concept development through pre-production, execution, dissolution, and legacy handover. Ensure full alignment with the Entertainment team in Zurich across all ceremonial workstreams. Manage the approval process for all ceremony related creative and operational deliverables. Múltiplas empresas de diferentes segmentos competem pela atenção e pelo bolso do consumidor e dos anunciantes. Essa constante transformação vem muito da própria evolução da tecnologia no mundo. Nesse cenário, a Globo vem buscando diferentes segmentos de audiência, novos produtos, novas estratégias de distribuição, novas formas de operar e novos modelos de negócio. Para suportar tanta transformação, precisamos entender os movimentos da indústria, o mercado cliente, a nossa estratégia de negócio, as tendências de tecnologia, nossas alavancas e nossos gaps. A área tem a missão de desenhar e propor estratégias, arquiteturas e roadmaps de evolução tecnológica para diversos domínios de negócio e foundations de tecnologia da empresa. Faz isso com uma abordagem focada nos principais desafios transformacionais da empresa, nos níveis estratégico e tático e de maneira muito colaborativa com outras áreas de tecnologia e do negócio. A área se estrutura nos papéis de arquitetura corporativa, arquitetura de soluções e arquitetura de dados & IA. Nos empenhamos em ser uma Globo cada vez mais diversa, em representatividade e pensamento, aprendendo uns com os outros e estimulando a criatividade e inovação. Desafios estratégicos O mercado de mídia e entretenimento vive numa constante transformação, com variadas formas, comportamentos, plataformas e monetização do consumo de conteúdo. Múltiplas empresas de diferentes segmentos competem pela atenção e pelo bolso do consumidor e dos anunciantes. Essa constante transformação vem muito da própria evolução da tecnologia no mundo. Nesse cenário, a Globo vem buscando diferentes segmentos de audiência, novos produtos, novas estratégias de distribuição, novas formas de operar e novos modelos de negócio. A área se estrutura nos papéis de arquitetura corporativa, arquitetura de soluções e arquitetura de dados & IA. title: Production Control Engineer
description: The Production Control Engineer will be responsible for ensuring the integrity, accuracy, and traceability of production data, acting as the technical authority for hydrocarbon accounting, allocation, reconciliation, and reporting across offshore facilities. Working closely with metering, subsurface, finance, and commercial teams, the role will guarantee reliable calculation and reporting of oil, gas, water, and associated fluids, while driving continuous improvement of accounting systems, data quality, and best practice. Responsibilities Ensure accurate hydrocarbon accounting for oil, gas, water, and associated fluids, including production allocation, reconciliation, inventory management, ullage calculations, and custody transfer, as well as injection, waste, and emissions, performed within internal and industry standards with due diligence, analysis, and data validation. Work closely with Metering, Subsurface, and Facilities teams to review production data and uncertainties, address measurement and reconciliation discrepancies, and coordinate corrective actions. Perform, validate, and approve daily, monthly, and annual production reconciliations between metering systems, tank inventories, export measurements, and allocation calculations prior to regulatory and internal reporting. Support the classification and allocation of production deferment or losses according to internal guidelines. Review, maintain, and improve all hydrocarbon and fluids accounting processes, reporting routines, data acquisition, models, and methodologies, ensuring accurate distribution of production volumes and compliance with internal, industry, and regulatory requirements. Maintain the integrity and reliability of production accounting data, systems, and processes, ensuring full traceability and auditability of all reported figures. Participate in operational reviews and provide production accounting input to support operational decision making. Act as the technical focal point for production control and hydrocarbon accounting matters within the organization. Support regulatory audits, inspections, and data requests related to production and other fluids accounting. Prepare, validate, and submit mandatory monthly and annual production reports to the Brazilian regulatory authority (ANP). Support the implementation and maintenance of production accounting tools and data analytics platforms. Promote automation and digitalization initiatives related to production data management and reporting. Education Bachelor's Degree in any field of Engineering Experience Experience in this position in the Oil and Gas industry. Knowledge Familiar with metering regulation and best industry standards such as ANP, RTM, API, SOX Experience in hydrocarbon accounting and production data management Good understanding and knowledge of FPSO marine & process systems Knowledge of programming languages such as Python, SQL Knowledge in Hydrocarbon Accounting Tools (such as Energy Components, EnergySys, PDM) #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Lead Developer (Ruby)
description: A Nuuvem, uma líder na distribuição digital de jogos na América Latina, é conhecida por sua paixão profunda por jogos e uma forte presença no mercado. Você precisa ser obcecado em produzir código de alta qualidade rapidamente, visualizando qualquer funcionalidade como parte do valor total da plataforma, sem perder o foco em entregar resultados. Segurança e desempenho devem ser suas prioridades principais. Ao mesmo tempo, você precisa se preocupar genuinamente com o crescimento e bem-estar das pessoas do seu time, sendo capaz de inspirar, orientar e desenvolver profissionais com autonomia e responsabilidade. Esta oportunidade é válida para trabalho remoto. Iremos fornecer todos os equipamentos necessários para você mandar bem no seu trabalho, seja ele onde você escolher ser! Você só precisa garantir uma internet de qualidade. Principais Responsabilidades: No lado técnico (Developer): Projetar, desenvolver e testar novos recursos para a plataforma, mantendo atuação técnica relevante e consistente. Manter e melhorar a base de código atual, corrigindo rapidamente bugs e refatorando códigos problemáticos quando necessário. Escrever código claro e organizado com base em separação de responsabilidades e na arquitetura do projeto, seguindo a semântica correta dos subdomínios do time. Promover padrões, boas práticas, testes balanceados pela pirâmide de testes e revisões de código consistentes, elevando a qualidade coletiva. Liderar pesquisas e experimentos ao lidar com requisitos novos e desafiadores. Realizar trabalhos complexos como planejamento de capacidade, testes de carga e melhorias de segurança. No lado de liderança e gestão (Tech Leader): Conduzir 1:1s regulares, definir e acompanhar Planos de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDIs), realizar avaliações de desempenho e apoiar o bem‑estar e equilíbrio de carga do time. Estruturar e melhorar continuamente rituais do time: planejamento, dailies, reviews/demos e retrospectivas, garantindo cadência e previsibilidade. Co‑definir o roadmap técnico com Produto, tomando decisões sobre trade-offs de escopo, custo e prazo, e garantindo alinhamento com objetivos da empresa. Coordenar iniciativas de confiabilidade (observabilidade, performance, segurança) e conduzir manutenções de risco com planejamento e comunicação para impacto mínimo aos clientes. Definir, medir e comunicar métricas do time (throughput, lead time, cycle time, qualidade, cobertura de testes, disponibilidade, débito técnico), usando‑as para decisões e coaching. Liderar a resposta a incidentes dentro do escopo da equipe, coordenando pessoas, priorizando ações e garantindo comunicação clara com stakeholders. Participar de recrutamento/seleção, onboarding e identificação de futuras lideranças. Você tem o perfil que buscamos se… Você tem proficiência e habilidades de comunicação em inglês verbal e escrito (não precisa ser fluente, mas precisa ser capaz de ler e escrever bem em inglês). Você é apaixonado por tecnologia (e jogos!). Você é um leitor voraz de livros. Você é capaz de entender os requisitos de negócios e traduzi-los em definições técnicas. Você faz perguntas poderosas - a partir disso, vamos (re)definir histórias de usuários, critérios de aceitação, especificações. Sempre questionando (sem perder o foco). Você vê o quadro geral dos problemas e é obcecado com detalhes (relevantes). Você toma decisões técnicas pensando no longo prazo, não apenas em “fazer funcionar agora”. Você também é orientado por resultados/entrega e é um solucionador de problemas. Você tem orgulho do código que escreve e se importa genuinamente com a saúde e evolução dele no futuro. Você tem um saudável desrespeito pelo “impossível”. Você se preocupa genuinamente com o crescimento das pessoas e entende que o sucesso do time é o seu sucesso. Você sabe dar e receber feedbacks de forma respeitosa, direta e construtiva. Você consegue discordar e se comprometer, equilibrando opiniões técnicas com decisões do grupo e da empresa. Em que acreditamos… Pair programming é sempre uma boa ideia. Código sem boa cobertura de testes automatizado está incompleto (além de não ser profissional). Todo que pode ser automatizado, deve ser automatizado. Qualidade e quantidade estão em equilíbrio - estamos sempre em busca desse equilíbrio. Um bom produto vem de uma ótima experiência e valor entregue. Ouvir, muitas vezes, é mais importante do que falar. Mostrar é melhor do que contar. O trabalho remoto deve ser predominantemente assíncrono, deixando os momentos síncronos para quando são realmente melhor aproveitados. Documentação clara, extensa (porém concisa) e atualizada vale ouro, e é um dos segredos do nosso sucesso. Importante não deixe de aplicar caso não tenha todos os conhecimentos ou experiências acima! Sua capacidade de aprendizado e evolução é mais importante do que um "checklist" de conhecimentos e experiências prévias. Por isso, todo colaborador tem o saldo de $70 dólares (aproximadamente R$345,00) por semestre para investir em seu crescimento profissional, seja em forma de curso, livro, workshop, eventos, etc. 4 Days Off 4you: aqui na Nuuvem todo mundo ganha 4 dias de folga por ano para tirar quando você quiser. Carrinho de Jogo do Mês: Se eu te contar que todo mês você pode escolher quantos itens quiser da nossa loja, até atingir o valor total de R$360,00, você acredita? É isso mesmo, jogos totalmente grátis, do seu jeito e sem burocracia. Escolheu, jogou! Cupom de 20%: Aí que a gente vê quem é amigo! Além do item do mês você ainda tem direito a 10 cupons de 20% na nossa loja anualmente para usar com você mesmo ou para dar de presente para amigos e familiares. A biblioteca de jogos agradece! Open English: Quem nunca jogou um game em inglês, não é mesmo? Temos uma parceria super legal com a Open English para aprimorar o seu inglês e/ou espanhol! Wellhub (antigo Gympass): Ficar sentado no computador o dia todo não dá, né? Oferecemos acesso ao App Wellhub que tem convênio com diversas academia, estúdios e também inclui terapia, nutrição e treinos online. AVUS: Porque saúde é prioridade para a Nuuvem! Com essa plataforma de benefícios, nosso time tem acesso a assistência virtual de alta qualidade e uma rede de profissionais em todo o Brasil, garantindo cuidados médicos personalizados a qualquer hora e lugar. title: Eletricista de Transmissão Júnior (Novo Horizonte - SP)
description: Descrição da vaga Estamos buscando Eletricista de Transmissão Júnior para atuar em nosso time de Manutenção. Responsabilidades e atribuições Apoiar a execução de manutenções preventivas e corretivas em linhas de transmissão, conforme procedimentos, instruções de trabalho e orientação do eletricista líder/encarregado da atividade. Auxiliar inspeções de rotina em estruturas, acessórios e componentes da linha e da faixa de servidão, registrando condições observadas e evidências conforme padrão adotado. Apoiar atividades de manejo de vegetação relacionadas à manutenção da linha e acessos (roçada, poda e corte), conforme procedimentos e orientação da liderança. Auxiliar atividades de manutenção em campo, incluindo preparação da frente de trabalho, organização do local, isolamento e sinalização, e recomposição/limpeza da área após a execução. Apoiar atividades de manutenção em estruturas e componentes de linha, atuando em altura quando requerido, sempre sob orientação e conforme requisitos de segurança aplicáveis. Manusear ferramentas manuais e elétricas e equipamentos de apoio à manutenção, zelando pela conservação, organização e uso adequado. Apoiar atividades de mobilização e logística de campo, incluindo carregamento/descarregamento e organização de materiais, ferramentas e equipamentos necessários às frentes de serviço. Apoiar medições e verificações de campo relacionadas às rotinas de manutenção/inspeção (quando aplicável e autorizado), registrando resultados e evidências conforme procedimentos. Atuar como apoio ao Técnico de Manutenção da localidade em atividades em subestações, compondo equipe para atendimento a requisitos de segurança e execução, sob orientação do técnico responsável pela atividade. Permanecer de sobreaviso quando escalado e atuar no atendimento de ocorrências e manobras associadas às intervenções, sob coordenação do Centro de Operação e liderança local. Registrar apontamentos, checklists, fotos e informações de execução no sistema corporativo de gestão de manutenção, conforme padrões de rastreabilidade definidos. Reportar anomalias, desvios e necessidades de intervenção ao eletricista líder/encarregado e à supervisão, contribuindo para priorização e encaminhamento. Apoiar a conservação e a manutenção básica das instalações e infraestrutura de apoio (predial/civil leve), conforme diretrizes locais. Cumprir rigorosamente normas, procedimentos e requisitos de segurança (incluindo NR-10, NR-35 e regras locais), interrompendo atividades e comunicando a liderança quando identificar condição insegura. Conduzir veículos da empresa, zelando pela utilização correta, conservação e segurança, bem como pelo adequado uso e preservação de EPI’s, EPC’s, ferramentas e instrumentos de trabalho. Requisitos e qualificações Requisitos: Ensino médio completo. Formação profissional/qualificação na área elétrica (ex.: Eletricista de Manutenção, Eletricista de Linhas ou equivalente). Aptidão para atividades em campo, incluindo condições para atuação em trabalho em altura quando requerido. CNH categoria B. Requisitos Desejáveis: Vivência inicial em manutenção/inspeção de linhas de transmissão ou distribuição. Noções de leitura e interpretação de desenhos/arranjos e procedimentos de campo. Possui conhecimento de normas, regulamentos, códigos de obras, padrões de fabricação e práticas padrão de projetos, relevantes para o controle e desenvolvimento. Experiência na área de Engenharia Civil no segmento de energias convencionais, em projetos multidisciplinares, projetos de estruturas em concreto armado, projeto de estruturas metálicas, dimensionamento estrutural, cálculo dos quantitativos, revisão/avaliação de projetos. Pré-dimensionamento e/ou dimensionamento das estruturas em concreto armado e verificação de metálicas, cálculo dos quantitativos, elaboração de croquis, montagem de memória de cálculo, montagem de planilha de quantidades, acompanhamento de elaboração de desenhos de forma, armação, chumbadores, insertos, unifilares e modelo 3D. Inglês (conversa, escrita e compreensão). Conhecimento do Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel e Teams. Pode navegar em páginas da intranet, realizar pesquisas e sintetizar as informações, organizando de acordo com políticas prescritas. Conhecimento em softwares de dimensionamento/verificação estrutural tipo: SAP2000, STAAD.Pro, TQS, Robot, etc. Responsabilidades Reúne dados de múltiplas fontes e prepara estudos de engenharia, análises, cálculos, etc. Elabora recomendações e prepara documentação final. Determina problemas técnicos, atua no desenvolvimento de soluções alternativas, estabelece prós/contras para várias soluções e faz recomendações através de documentos oficiais do projeto, como consultas técnicas, desvios técnicos, etc. Cria a documentação final incorporando todas as informações relevantes e busca a aprovação do cliente. Pode revisar documentação semelhante para ajudar outros e revisar/autorizar o trabalho feito pelo time. Avaliação de documentação técnica dos projetos, revisão dos documentos e consolidação de comentários. Elaboração de critérios de projetos, especificações técnicas e/ou de serviços, memorial descritivo das estruturas em concreto armado e apoio ao Supervisor da disciplina. Se você tem paixão e talento para se manter atualizado, é hora de testar os limites do que você pode se tornar. Encontre seu futuro na Worley. #J-18808-Ljbffr
